book.name: ROMANOS
book.title: U Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLOXEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU ROMA U uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Roma uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: Niyolon u Pablo tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ u Abraham ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ
¿As kam la qal qꞌi tiꞌ u qꞌesla kubꞌaaleꞌ uvaꞌ Abraham, oꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ tiaal Israel? ¿As kam qꞌi kat ibꞌan u Abraham tul atik tzitzaꞌ vatz txꞌavaꞌ?
As kat koj ok u Abraham jikla aamail tiꞌ inimat u tzaqꞌiteꞌ skajayil, as la ucheꞌ uvaꞌ la toksa iqꞌii. As jit vatz u Tiixheꞌ la ibꞌankat.
As ech kat ibꞌan u Abraham echeꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal umaꞌl u yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: As kat ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ u Abraham ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ kat toksa veꞌt Aak u Abraham jikla aamail, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: As echeꞌ umaj uxhchil uvaꞌ ni taqꞌonveꞌ, tan jit oyeꞌ nibꞌanax ste, asoj aqꞌon kat ibꞌana tiꞌ itxꞌakat ipuaj. As tetz chiteꞌ uvaꞌ la choopi.

Pet ech koj u Abraham, tan jit tiꞌ uveꞌ kat inima u Abraham u tzaqꞌiteꞌ as kat ok jikla aamail. Pet tukꞌ kuxh vibꞌaꞌnil u Tiixheꞌ kat oksal u Abraham jikla aamail, tan Aakeꞌ ni oksan unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ jikla aamail, abꞌil uvaꞌ nikꞌujbꞌaꞌ ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak, kꞌuxh aapaavike.
As ech kat tal kan u David ileꞌ tiꞌ umaj uxhchil uvaꞌ la ok jikla aamail. As achvebꞌal u uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ la toksa u Tiixheꞌ jikla aamail, kꞌuxh yeꞌ ninima u tzaqꞌiteꞌ skajayil.
As ech tal kan u David ileꞌ unpajte:

content.text: Achvebꞌal chit unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ kat isotzsa u Tiixheꞌ ipaav tiꞌ u paasan tziileꞌ uvaꞌ nibꞌaneꞌ.
As yeꞌ ni toksa Aak vipaav unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ stuul.
As achvebꞌal chit unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌl veꞌt ipaav vatz u Kubꞌaal Tiixheꞌ, tiꞌk u yoleꞌ.

content: ¿Pet ma aꞌ kuxh unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ kat eesal unbꞌiil vichiꞌoleꞌ uveꞌ achvebꞌal vatz u Tiixheꞌ? ¿Pet moj antu unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌl unbꞌiil vichiꞌoleꞌ kat eesali? Tan kat vala tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ u Abraham ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ kat tal Aak uvaꞌ jikla aama veꞌt u Abraham.

¿As ma maꞌtik teesal unbꞌiil vichiꞌol u Abraham tul uvaꞌ kat tal Aak uvaꞌ jikla aama veꞌt u Abraham, as moj yeꞌle? Yeꞌle taꞌ, tan yeꞌxnik el unbꞌiil vichiꞌol u Abrahameꞌ tul kat tal Aak uvaꞌ jikla aama veꞌteꞌ.

As tul kat eesal unbꞌiil vichiꞌol u Abraham, as maꞌtik talat u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ jikla aama veꞌteꞌ. As tul kat eesal unbꞌiil vichiꞌoleꞌ, as aꞌ veꞌt kꞌuchbꞌal tetz uvaꞌ jikla aama veꞌt u Abraham vatz u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ u kꞌujlebꞌal ikꞌuꞌleꞌ. As kat oksal veꞌt u Abrahameꞌ bꞌaalail tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil, abꞌil uvaꞌ la ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ veꞌt ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak, as jikla aama veꞌt unqꞌa tenameꞌ vatz Aak unpajte, as kꞌuxh yeꞌl unbꞌiil vichiꞌoleꞌ eesamal.

As kat toksa veꞌt Aak u Abraham bꞌaalail sqiꞌ, oꞌ uvaꞌ eesamal veꞌt unbꞌiil u kuchiꞌoleꞌ. As aꞌ veꞌt u Abraham bꞌaal setiꞌ unpajte, jankꞌal ex uvaꞌ kat ekꞌujbꞌaꞌ veꞌt ekꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan u Abraham, tul uvaꞌ yeꞌxnik eesal unbꞌiil vichiꞌoleꞌ.
Ni tal u Pablo uvaꞌ tiꞌ u kꞌujlebꞌal kꞌuꞌleꞌ la kꞌulpukat vibꞌaꞌnil u Tiixheꞌ

As jit tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat inima u Abraham u tzaqꞌiteꞌ kat talkat u Tiixheꞌ ste as tukꞌ te unqꞌa tiaaleꞌ, tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ok vaatzil ibꞌaal unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil. Pet tiꞌ uvaꞌ kat ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ veꞌt u Abraham ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ uvaꞌ alel kan taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ, as tiꞌ uvaꞌ jikla aama veꞌteꞌ vatz Aak.

Tan kat koj ok u Abraham tukꞌ unqꞌa tiaaleꞌ vaatzi ibꞌaal unqꞌa tenameꞌ skajayil tiꞌ uvaꞌ maꞌtik inimat u tzaqꞌiteꞌ, as yeꞌl tokebꞌaleꞌ bꞌa u kꞌujlebꞌal ikꞌuꞌleꞌ. As yeꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ bꞌa echeꞌ uvaꞌ alel kan ste taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ,

tan aꞌ u tzaqꞌiteꞌ ni alon uvaꞌ at tzan vitxꞌiꞌtziꞌl u Tiixheꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ taꞌn vipaasan tziileꞌ vatz Aak. Pet jankꞌal unqꞌa tenameꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ ootzimal u tzaqꞌiteꞌ staꞌn uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa kan u Moisés, as jit ipaasa unqꞌa tenameꞌ tzii vatz u tzaqꞌiteꞌ.

Estiꞌeꞌ kat tal kan u Tiixheꞌ u yoleꞌ te u Abraham tiꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌujleꞌl ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak. As tukꞌ vibꞌaꞌnil Aakeꞌ kat tal kan Aak u yoleꞌ, aqꞌal uvaꞌ la ikꞌul unqꞌa tiaal u Abraham u bꞌaꞌnileꞌ uvaꞌ alel kan taꞌn Aak. As jit kuxh unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ kat tal kan Aak ste uvaꞌ ootzin tetz u tzaqꞌiteꞌ. Pet te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ unpajte uvaꞌ nikꞌujbꞌaꞌ ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak echeꞌ uvaꞌ ibꞌan u Abraham. Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ aꞌ veꞌt u Abraham vaatzil kubꞌaal, jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌujleꞌl kukꞌuꞌl tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ,
echeꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ:

content.text: «Tan kat unkꞌujbꞌaꞌ kan axh ibꞌaal unqꞌa mamaꞌla tenameꞌ,» tiꞌk u Tiixheꞌ tal te u Abraham.

content: As aꞌ veꞌt u Abraham kubꞌaal vatz u Tiixheꞌ, tan kat ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ u Abraham ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak. As tul Aakeꞌ ni aqꞌon itiichajil unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌlik itiichajil kꞌatz Aak. As Aakeꞌ cheesan tetz unqꞌa veeꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌxhkam atike, echeꞌ uvaꞌ kat ibꞌan Aak te u Abraham.

Tan kat ikꞌujbꞌaꞌ u Abraham ikꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak. Estiꞌeꞌ kat toksa veꞌt Aak u Abraham vaatzil kubꞌaal tiꞌ u mamaꞌla tenameꞌ, kꞌuxh yeꞌ nik ipal u Abraham stuul uvaꞌ kam stiꞌ uvaꞌ la okkat bꞌaalail tiꞌ u tenameꞌ, echeꞌ uvaꞌ maꞌtik talat kan u Tiixheꞌ ste, tan ech kat tal Aak ileꞌ:

content.text: Yeꞌ saach unqꞌa aviaaleꞌ tuk ibꞌaneꞌ, tiꞌk Aak.

content: As yeꞌ kat kaꞌkabꞌin taama u Abraham tiꞌ u kꞌujlebꞌal ikꞌuꞌleꞌ, kꞌuxh ootzimalik staꞌn uvaꞌ maꞌtik ipal veꞌt iyakꞌil vichiꞌoleꞌ. As ech veꞌteꞌ echeꞌ kamnaj uvaꞌ nik titzꞌa veꞌt u Abraham, tan bꞌiitik kuxh ibꞌanat oꞌ kꞌalal (100) yaabꞌ. As echat veꞌt u Sara, tan maꞌtik ipal veꞌt iyakꞌil vichiꞌoleꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ la alani.
As yeꞌ kat kaꞌkabꞌin taama u Abraham tiꞌ u yoleꞌ uvaꞌ tal u Tiixheꞌ ste. Pet aal kat yakꞌin veꞌt taama tiꞌ u kꞌujlebꞌal ikꞌuꞌleꞌ tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ. As kat toksa veꞌt iqꞌii u Tiixheꞌ,
tan ootzimalik taꞌn u Abraham uvaꞌ la chit ibꞌan u Tiixheꞌ kam uvaꞌ altziꞌmal kan taꞌn Aak.
Tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌujleꞌl ikꞌuꞌl u Abraham tiꞌ u Tiixheꞌ, as estiꞌeꞌ kat tal veꞌt Aak uvaꞌ jikla aama veꞌt u Abraham.
As jit kuxh tiꞌ u Abraham tzꞌibꞌamalkat kan u yoleꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ jikla aama veꞌteꞌ.
Pet antu veꞌt oꞌ uvaꞌ ni tal u Tiixheꞌ uvaꞌ oꞌ veꞌt jikla aama vatz Aak, jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ kꞌujleꞌl kukꞌuꞌl tiꞌ Aak uvaꞌ tukꞌ vibꞌaꞌnil Aakeꞌ kat tulsa Aak taama u Kubꞌaal Jesús.
As kat oksal veꞌt ok u Jesús tiqꞌabꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ tiꞌ iyatzꞌpeꞌ tiꞌ u kupaasan tziileꞌ uvaꞌ nu kubꞌaneꞌ. As kat tulsa veꞌt Aak taama u Jesús, tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ok veꞌt oꞌ jikla aamail vatz Aak.
